title: Taiwan Aid Enhances Agricultural Analysis in St. Lucia
reason: Provides an overview of a technical training program for agricultural diagnostic facilities.

tasks.task: Explain the objectives and participants of the training program.

subtasks.text: The training covered HPLC principles, analytical methods, and AAS principles for six participants.
